regions.purpose: Identifies the surface and holds Done, which commits the Collection and continues into it, and Cancel, which discards uncommitted changes.
The Collection's own identity — name, description, and appearance (color, pin style). The only place this metadata is editable.
The Review template — the ordered field set governing every Review in this Collection. Add fields, adopt a built-in template, and edit each field in place.

altAffordances.label: Finish editing (return to map and commit candidate)
altAffordances.note: Same Save affordance as DONE. Fires this alt event when return-to-draft-context is set (editor reached from AddLocationToCollection's TAP_NEW_COLLECTION). The host commits the in-flight candidate Location against the just-created Collection (Location.addToCollection) and emerges in MapOverview with pending-review-context.

affordances.label: Edit the Collection's name, description, and appearance
Adopt a built-in template as a starting point

shows: the field's type — score, text, enum, boolean, date, power-ranking
the field's per-type configuration — for a score field, its range, step, and render style (number, stars, icon, slider, bar); for an enum, its option list

affordance.label: Edit, reorder, or remove a field

lists.emptyState: A template with no fields — the region prompts the user to add a field or adopt a built-in template. An empty template is a valid (if unusual) end state; a Collection with one leaves ReviewForm nothing to fill.
